Car Body Technician & Painter – Skill Bridge ApS

We are looking for dedicated professionals who value precision, high-quality work, and reliability.

• 
Assess and repair vehicle body damage including dents, panels, and structural components

• 
Perform welding, cutting, and metal straightening as required

• 
Prepare surfaces through sanding, masking, and application of filler and primer

• 
Mix and apply paint using spray equipment to manufacturer colour and finish standards

• 
Carry out full and partial resprays including blending and lacquer application

• 
Replace or repair damaged body panels, bumpers, and glass

• 
Operate frame and chassis straightening equipment

• 
Inspect and quality-check finished bodywork and paintwork before delivery

Qualifications

• 
Knowledge of vehicle body repair methods and paint mixing systems

• 
Experience with spray painting equipment and paint booth operation

• 
Ability to colour-match and blend paint to a high standard

• 
Ability to work independently and take responsibility for finished quality

• 
Communicates in English (Danish is an advantage)

• 
Category B driving licence preferred

We Offer

• 
Full-time employment with Skill Bridge ApS

• 
Work at multiple locations across Denmark

• 
Competitive salary and good working conditions

• 
Assistance with accommodation and practical matters (if required)

Opportunity for long-term cooperation and professional development

Application Send your CV to: info@skillbridge.dk Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted.

About Skill Bridge ApS Skill Bridge ApS connects skilled and semi-skilled workers with Danish companies in the automotive, industrial, construction, and service sectors. We focus on professionalism, safety, and fair working conditions for all our employees and partners.

Department: Sales EMEA

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers improve performance with an AI-enabled, plug-and-play manufacturing intelligence suite. Real-time visibility on the shop floor. Connected operations. Data that actually turns into improvement, not just reports.

We’re expanding our Northern European sales team in Copenhagen and looking for a Business Development Representative to help us keep building momentum and opening doors in a market where we already have a solid presence. You’ll work from our Copenhagen office and support our Danish and Swedish markets, so we’re looking for someone fluent in both languages.

This is a great role for someone early in their sales career who wants more than a script to follow: someone who wants to help shape our outbound approach, sharpen their craft with modern prospecting tools, and sell something that makes a real difference on the factory floor.

**About the Role

**As a BDR at Factbird, you won’t just be executing outreach. You’ll be helping sharpen the playbook for how we generate pipeline in Denmark and Sweden. That means a mix of hands-on prospecting and real input into strategy: which accounts to target, which messages resonate, and which channels and tools actually move the needle.

You’ll spend your time identifying the right accounts, reaching the right people, testing what works, and turning interest into qualified meetings and sales opportunities.

This is a phone-first role. Phone calls remain your primary tool, but you’ll also run structured multi-channel campaigns across email and LinkedIn, and use AI-powered prospecting tools to work smarter, not just harder.

**Key Responsibilities

**We’re looking for someone who understands that outbound success comes from a combination of activity, discipline, messaging, and follow-through. This role is aligned with market expectations for outbound development work, including periods where 100-200 call attempts per day may be required, depending on territory focus, campaign goals, and lead quality.

What you'll do

• Build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting into manufacturing and industrial accounts across Denmark and Sweden

• Respond to inbound leads, qualify interest, and convert it into meetings

• Research target accounts to understand business context, likely pain points, and buying relevance

• Identify the right decision-makers and stakeholders within target organizations

• Book discovery meetings for the Account Management team and create qualified opportunities

• Maintain strong prospect data quality and keep HubSpot accurate and up to date

• Track your performance against KPIs and stay disciplined about activity and follow-up

• Work closely with the Account Management and Marketing teams to sharpen targeting, messaging, and handoff quality

• Bring insights from prospect conversations back to the team: what’s resonating, what isn’t

**How we'll measure success

**KPIs will be defined with your manager, but here's what we're tracking:

• Sales-qualified leads generated

• Discovery meetings booked and completed

• Conversion from leads to qualified opportunities

• Outreach volume, especially calls

• Inbound lead response time

• CRM discipline and data quality

This role is for someone who wants to see a direct line between their daily work, the strategies they help build, and commercial growth.

**About you

**You want to build a career in sales, and you’re ready for a role where you get real ownership, not just a list of calls to make. You’re comfortable in an outbound environment, curious about tools and experimentation, and motivated by the opportunity to improve fast.

We’re looking for someone with:

• 1-3 years of experience as an SDR in a B2B SaaS environment

• Fluency in Danish and Swedish, and strong English

• A strong interest in pipeline generation and outbound prospecting

• Comfort working in a phone-first sales development role

• The ability to succeed in a high-activity environment, including periods of 100-200 calls per day

• Curiosity about the manufacturing world and interest in learning how manufacturers operate

• Strong follow-through and personal ownership

• Experience working in a CRM, ideally HubSpot

• Hunger for a long-term career in sales

If you’re excited by building pipelines, learning fast, and helping bring modern software into manufacturing environments, we’d love to hear from you.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

• Flexible working hours — we trust you to manage your time

• Competitive salary — compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact

• Internet reimbursement — stay connected wherever you choose to work from

• Thoughtful, human onboarding — step-by-step support from day one

• Individual Development Plan conversations — bi-yearly career development aligned to your ambitions

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days — we come together regularly across teams and regions

• A global, inclusive culture — diverse backgrounds and perspectives, actively celebrated

**Join Us

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit, feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Apply directly or reach out with questions to our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead, Khristel, at khma@factbird.com.

Please note that applications will be reviewed after November 20th.

_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

DevOps Engineer - Keep the Engine Room Running at RiskPoint

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for a curious and methodical DevOps Engineer to join their growing IT-team. If you are building your DevOps skills and would rather see your work running in production than parked in a slide deck, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies. With more than 325 employees in 18 locations, RiskPoint combines deep underwriting expertise with in-house claims handling and strong business support.

As a DevOps Engineer at RiskPoint, you will become part of a cross-functional global IT-organisation within Finance and Operations, spanning development, architecture, data, infrastructure, and business partnering. RiskPoint is targeting a doubling of the business over the next three years, powered by a digital and AI portfolio built in-house: rating engines on one shared core, AI pipelines that read and route transaction documents, and renewal workbenches redesigned from actual underwriter voice notes. All of it depends on builds, deployments, and environments that simply work.

RiskPoint operates in an agile, collaborative environment with strong cross-border cooperation. Several systems are mid-migration at any given moment, and changes ship across Cyber, Directors and Officers (D&O), Transaction Risk, and Property in parallel. If that sounds chaotic, it is the fun kind. With a flat structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers real impact, ownership, and room to grow.

About the Position:

As a DevOps Engineer at RiskPoint, you will help the teams deliver software reliably by supporting delivery pipelines, cloud environments in Microsoft Azure, and day-to-day automation. You will work close to the engine room of the digital and AI portfolio, helping keep the platforms behind rating engines, AI pipelines, and business applications stable, secure, and repeatable.

This is a role for someone who is building their DevOps skills. You will start with well-defined tasks and build confidence through pairing, code reviews, and guided troubleshooting with experienced colleagues. The focus is on contribution and learning rather than architecture or leadership, and there is real room to grow.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office, and you will collaborate closely with developers, architects, operations and security colleagues, as well as external vendors.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Support CI/CD pipelines by maintaining build, test, and deployment steps, investigating failures, and validating changes before release

• 
Assist with cloud and infrastructure configuration in Microsoft Azure, including routine maintenance and environment checks

• 
Make small, reviewed Infrastructure as Code changes, for example in Terraform, and write or adapt scripts that automate repeatable tasks

• 
Support Kubernetes-based deployments and Helm-based configuration to keep runtime environments stable and consistent

• 
Monitor dashboards, alerts, and logs, troubleshoot methodically, record findings, and escalate when needed

• 
Follow good security and access practice, including least privilege, safe secret handling, and prompt reporting of potential risks

• 
Maintain clear setup guides and runbooks

• 
Use AI tools to understand unfamiliar scripts, draft documentation, and speed up troubleshooting, always with review before production

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

Your Profile - A Great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, analytical, and pragmatic DevOps Engineer who enjoys working a problem through until it is solved, and documenting it so that nobody has to solve it twice.

You have a relevant education within Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar discipline, though equivalent practical experience counts just as much as the diploma.

The role carries an underlying expectation: you use AI to build your own methodology, not just RiskPoint's products, and reach for it by default.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Foundational knowledge of Git, including commits, branches, and pull requests

• 
An understanding of basic cloud concepts, operating systems, and networking

• 
The ability to read and adapt simple scripts in PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar

• 
A methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the patience to work a problem through and record what you find

• 
Clear communication and a willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and document solutions

• 
An interest in agile delivery environments using Jira and GitHub as core engineering tools

You are humble and comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and you see feedback as fuel rather than criticism.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• 
Some exposure to Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions

• 
Some exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep

• 
Some exposure to containers such as Docker, and to Kubernetes or Helm

• 
Personal projects or coursework where you have built, deployed, or automated something end to end

Ready for the next step?

If you are as comfortable discussing a pricing factor or a data schema as you are discussing sprint velocity, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies. With more than 325 employees in 18 locations, RiskPoint combines deep underwriting expertise with in-house claims handling and strong business support.

As a Product Owner at RiskPoint, you will become part of a cross-functional global IT-organisation within Finance and Operations, spanning development, architecture, data, infrastructure, and business partnering. RiskPoint is targeting a doubling of the business over the next three years, powered by a digital and AI portfolio built in-house: rating engines on one shared core, AI pipelines that read and route transaction documents, and renewal workbenches redesigned from actual underwriter voice notes. Every new idea is scored through RiskPoint's Portfolio Innovation framework before a line of code gets written.

RiskPoint operates in an agile, collaborative environment with strong cross-border cooperation. Several systems are mid-migration at any given moment, and changes ship across Cyber, Directors and Officers (D&O), Transaction Risk, and Property in parallel. If that sounds chaotic, it is the fun kind. With a flat structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers real impact, ownership, and room to grow.

About the Position:

As a Product Owner for Rating Engines at RiskPoint, you will own the most data-intensive systems in the portfolio: the rating engines that price the risk, and the portfolio management tooling that gives underwriting leadership a real-time view of exposure, concentration, and performance across lines. This is not a roadmap of screens and forms. It is a roadmap of models, calibration logic, and data pipelines.

You will decide what is a Quick Win, what is a Strategic Bet, and what is a Wildcard worth a flutter, with a meaningful share of the ideas coming from data science and actuarial, not just underwriting. You roll out changes through a staged, evidence-led ramp rather than a big bang, and you know when a change touches live pricing and needs a careful hand.

RiskPoint is not hiring to maintain what exists, but to build what doubles the business. That means real ownership, a genuine mandate from leadership, and work that ships in weeks, not quarters, and runs in production rather than gathering dust as a pilot.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Own the backlog and roadmap for the rating engines, including the shared pricing core, product-specific rating logic, and the calibration and versioning discipline that keeps a live pricing system trustworthy

• 
Own the backlog and roadmap for portfolio management tooling, including exposure aggregation, concentration risk, and loss ratio trending

• 
Prioritise using the 5is framework (Inventory, Ideate, Incubate, Implementation, Iteration), scoring ideas against evidence, sponsorship, and sized benefit before they are resourced

• 
Write requirements and acceptance criteria that hold up against a data pipeline and a model, not just a user interface

• 
Partner with data science and engineers on the underlying models, understanding what drives a price change well enough to defend it to underwriting

• 
Define what good looks like for a new pricing factor or model version, and know when it needs data science or actuarial sign-off

• 
Sequence model and feature rollouts across regions and lines of business, from shadow mode through partial live to full automation, based on measured accuracy and error rates

• 
Use AI tools yourself to query rating engine output logs, run quick data explorations, and draft technical requirements against a schema

• 
Own stakeholder communication end to end, briefing leadership honestly about both what has shipped and what is still shaky

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

Your Profile - A Great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, analytical, and pragmatic Product Owner who can sit between underwriters, actuaries, data scientists, and leadership, and speak each of their languages fluently.

You have 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally owning a data-heavy or model-backed product such as a pricing engine, risk scoring, or an analytics platform.

The role carries an underlying expectation: you use AI to build your own methodology, not just RiskPoint's products, and reach for it by default.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Comfort reading model outputs and asking sharp, informed questions about them, even without a data science background yourself

• 
Genuine fluency in agile ceremonies, and the judgement to know when process should flex to reality

• 
A sharp instinct for MVP scoping: what ships now, and what waits

• 
Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in your own workflow for requirements, data exploration, or documentation

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to adjust your register to underwriters, actuaries, data scientists, and leadership

You are humble, and honest about uncertainty rather than dressing it up.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• Familiarity with how rating or pricing logic works in insurance or a comparable regulated, model-driven industry

Ready for the next step?

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is growing, and we are looking for a Senior CMC Writer to support global regulatory submissions across our expanding portfolio.

Your primary focus will be documentation for global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), New Drug Applications (NDAs), and responses to health authority questions during assessment. Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will transform complex CMC information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers collaborating across early and late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management. As a senior colleague, you will independently drive writing activities, provide expert review and mentoring, and help improve documentation practices through AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities include:

• Independently authoring and coordinating review of Module 3 CTD sections and supporting source documents covering manufacturing processes and controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facilities

• Working with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners to resolve review comments and deliver approved documents within agreed timelines

• Serving as a go-to reviewer for scientific accuracy, document quality, consistency, and regulatory alignment, including verification of data against source documentation

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and maintaining the resulting updates across submissions and programs

• Supporting late stage initial filings, global roll outs, lifecycle maintenance, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed, while maintaining source document trackers and traceability

• Applying and refining CMC writing and response principles, templates, procedures, and style guides in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable GxP requirements

• Using AI, automation, and digital tools to identify documentation gaps and improve writing quality and efficiency, with critical evaluation of outputs and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Mentoring colleagues in regulatory writing and digital documentation practices, and contributing to process improvements and departmental initiatives

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or a related technical discipline. An advanced degree, relevant certification, or equivalent experience is preferred.

You bring at least six years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience in global regulatory submissions and pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing. Direct experience supporting IND, CTA, BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is expected

• Demonstrated expertise in authoring and reviewing complex CMC regulatory sections and/or supporting source documents, with the ability to independently manage writing activities and guide other authors

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory expectations across development stages and strong knowledge of CTD structure, GxP, and relevant documentation requirements

• Excellent written English, sound scientific judgment, and the ability to present complex information clearly, assess supporting data, and identify gaps and inconsistencies

• Practical experience using AI to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including effective prompting, critical assessment of outputs, and verification of scientific content

• Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to align cross-functional stakeholders, resolve differing perspectives, and mentor colleagues

• A proven record of ownership, effective prioritization, and timely delivery, combined with curiosity, continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that builds trust, welcomes feedback, and supports an inclusive work environment

**Application deadline: 30 November 2026

**The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Your focus will be on building, evolving, and maintaining our CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure, while promoting DevOps best practices and strong software engineering principles across the organization.

Sylvia Health has developed a new medical device designed to offer better support, dignity and quality of life for women living with rectocele prolapse, a major subtype of pelvic organ prolapse.

Sylvia Health has developed a novel Class I/IIa medical device for rectocele prolapse support, designed to address an urgent unmet need in pelvic health.

MedTech go-to-market strategy

Major medical device markets, especially Europe

Early-stage company building, fundraising or investor relations

Do you want to play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of advanced drone systems used in mission-critical operations? As Quality Control Inspector at Sky-Watch, you will be responsible for inspecting, testing and verifying components to ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality standards and regulatory requirements. You will work hands-on with advanced technology and complex electronic components, contributing directly to the quality, safety and reliability of Sky-Watch’s products.

Working closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing and Operations, you will identify and address quality issues, support continuous improvements and ensure accurate documentation and traceability throughout the production process. You will become part of a growing Quality function, where you will collaborate with experienced colleagues and have opportunities for professional development and technical specialization.
